title: Foundation Mastery Check II
objective: Determine whether part/whole, zero, and number location are secure enough to move into Unit 1.1's Number Bond notation.

tasks.prompt: Given a whole (e.g. 8), produce at least two different two-part splits.
Given two parts, state the whole without recounting from 1.
State that zero is a valid count for an empty group, in a context with no physical objects present.
Place 3-4 given numbers correctly in order along an informal number path and state which of two numbers is farther from zero.

mastery.passEvidence: All four tasks completed correctly; the zero task specifically must use the word "zero" as an answer, not "none" or "nothing."
mastery.reteachTrigger: Produces only one split per whole and cannot find a second when prompted (reteach 0.2.2/0.2.4) or cannot state zero as a quantity outside a removal-demonstration context (reteach 0.2.5 with a non-object example).
